Income Statement
11Key Highlights
• Total Income increased 1.4% QoQ, supported by full -quarter 
revenue from VIH, partial revenue recognition from ROW 55, 
and PC utilities following the FH transfer, while declining 1.8% 
YoY due to lower income from ROW 55.
• Operating Expenses increased 228.2% QoQ due to the 
absence of a one -time expense reversal from the PC 
settlement in Q4/2025. On a YoY basis, expenses rose 7.8%, 
mainly from PC’s operating expenses.
• Expected Credit Loss (ECL) in Q1/2026 came solely from UD 
Plaza. In Q4/2025, a one -time THB 70.7 mm reversal related to 
the PC settlement was recorded, resulting in net ECL gain for 
the quarter.
• Net Investment Income (NII) decreased 98.3% QoQ but 
increased 130.7% YoY. In addition, there is no gain (loss) on 
investments in Q1/2026 as there was no asset revaluation 
during the quarter. Financial Highlights
